headline: Trump's FIFA call opens a 'slippery slope,' says sports columnist Christine Brennan
context: NPR's A Martínez speaks with USA Today sports columnist Christine Brennan about the World Cup match between the U.S. and Belgium and the lifted suspension of a U.S. star forward.
